description:
Title: Storage management

First, the order is read from the automatic order management system.
Then, it's checked if the first product from the order is in stock.
If it's in stock then it's withdrawn from the warehouse.
However, if it's not in stock then it's reordered from the wholesaler.
Note, that if it was necessary to wait more then 10 days for the arrival of the  product then a delivery delay penalty is automatically demanded from the wholesaler.
After the ordered product has arrived it's registered in the stock management system.
Finally, it's checked if the whole order is ready for shipment.
If the order is ready for shipment, a courier is requested and the products are packed simultaneously and finally shipped.
If it isn't then the next product from the order is selected and the process starts again with checking if this order is in stock or not.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_StorageManagement" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/storage-management">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ReorderRequest" name="Reorder request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CourierRequest" name="Courier request"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_StorageManagement">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" processRef="Process_StorageManagement"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Wholesaler" name="Wholesaler"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Courier" name="Courier"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ReorderRequest" name="Reorder request" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ProductArrival" name="Product arrival" sourceRef="Participant_Wholesaler" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProduct" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayPenalty" name="Delivery delay penalty" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Participant_Wholesaler" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CourierRequest" name="Courier request" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Participant_Courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_StorageManagement" name="Storage management" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Process" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReadOrder" name="Read order from automatic order management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckStock" name="Check whether the first product is in stock"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Stock" name="First product in stock?" default="Flow_Reorder"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_WithdrawProduct" name="Withdraw product from warehouse"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ReorderProduct" name="Reorder product from wholesaler" messageRef="Message_ReorderRequest"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveProduct" name="Receive ordered product" messageRef="Message_ProductArrival"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Delay" name="Arrival took more than 10 days?" default="Flow_NoPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_DemandPenalty" name="Automatically demand delivery delay penalty" messageRef="Message_DelayPenalty"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_DelayMerge" name="Continue after delay decision"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_RegisterProduct" name="Register product in stock management system"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckOrderReady" name="Check whether the whole order is ready for shipment"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OrderReady" name="Whole order ready for shipment?" default="Flow_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectNextProduct" name="Select next product from order"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" name="Request courier and pack products"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_RequestCourier" name="Request courier" messageRef="Message_CourierRequest"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PackProducts" name="Pack products"/>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" name="Courier requested and products packed"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ShipProducts" name="Ship products"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Shipped" name="Order shipped"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_ReadOrder" sourceRef="StartEvent_Process" targetRef="Task_ReadOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReadOrder_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_ReadOrder" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckStock_GatewayStock" sourceRef="Task_CheckStock" targetRef="Gateway_Stock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InStock" name="In stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_WithdrawProduct">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The first product is in stock</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder" name="Not in stock" sourceRef="Gateway_Stock" targetRef="Task_ReorderProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Withdraw_CheckOrderReady" sourceRef="Task_WithdrawProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reorder_ReceiveProduct" sourceRef="Task_ReorderProduct" targetRef="Task_ReceiveProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveProduct_GatewayDelay" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveProduct" targetRef="Gateway_Delay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DelayPenalty" name="More than 10 days" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay" targetRef="Task_DemandPenalty">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The wait for arrival exceeded 10 days</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoPenalty" name="10 days or less" sourceRef="Gateway_Delay" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Penalty_Merge" sourceRef="Task_DemandPenalty" targetRef="Gateway_DelayMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Register" sourceRef="Gateway_DelayMerge" targetRef="Task_RegisterProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Register_CheckOrderReady" sourceRef="Task_RegisterProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckOrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckOrderReady_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckOrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_OrderReady"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OrderReady" name="Order ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">The whole order is ready for shipment</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNextProduct" name="Order not ready" sourceRef="Gateway_OrderReady" targetRef="Task_SelectNextProduct"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SelectNext_CheckStock" sourceRef="Task_SelectNextProduct" targetRef="Task_CheckStock"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_RequestCourier" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_RequestCourier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_PackProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentSplit" targetRef="Task_PackProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RequestCourier_Join" sourceRef="Task_RequestCourier" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PackProducts_Join" sourceRef="Task_PackProducts" targetRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Join_ShipProducts" sourceRef="Gateway_ShipmentJoin" targetRef="Task_ShipProducts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ShipProducts_End" sourceRef="Task_ShipProducts" targetRef="EndEvent_Shipped"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
